description: blend/rim-fillet-into-a-step with the cut moved off the axis: the cylinder of radius 2 about z from 0 to 2 cut down to z 1 over x < 0, y > off at off 0.5, so the low rim is an arc from the step y = off, a plane parallel to the axis and off it, to the step x = 0, a plane through it; filleted at r 0.3. Both ends are mixed corners whose vertical edge on the cylinder is lengthened down past the vertex (ADR-0038): at x = 0 the step takes the torus's section, exact; at y = off each contact meets the step at its own angle and the step takes the torus's section by the plane, traced and fitted (ADR-0037). No closed form for the volume: the oracle's

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE keeps each consumed corner vertex on its lengthened vertical edge, two edges of one line between the same two faces; Arris lengthens the one edge to the trim (ADR-0038)
